_note: Transport allowance to an employee who is blind, deaf and dumb, or orthopaedically handicapped, for commuting between residence and duty: exempt up to the lesser of what was paid and the monthly limit times the months covered (D-102). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.2BB(2) Table Sl. 11, "blind [or deaf and dumb] or orthopaedically handicapped with disability of lower extremities … Whole of India [Rs. 3,200 per month]" — the brackets mark later substitutions, reported as S.O. 1002(E) of 13-4-2015 (the amount) and S.O. 2604(E) of 23-9-2015 ("or deaf and dumb"), neither read; in r.2BB(3)'s list (G.S.R. 452(E), "serial no. 11 of the Table"), so also for an assessee taxed under s.115BAC(1A). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.280(2) Table Sl. 10, "blind or deaf and dumb or orthopaedically handicapped with disability of lower or upper extremities … (i) Metro Cities: ₹15000 plus dearness allowance thereon per month. (ii) Other Cities: ₹8000 dearness allowance thereon per month"; in r.280(3)'s list, applied in the new regime per s.202(2)(a)(ii). The Rules define neither "Metro Cities" nor the dearness allowance "thereon" (OQ-7): the taxpayer states both as the employer applies them, and the other cities' row is read as "plus" like the metro row. No official interpretation of either defect exists; the owner rules these readings settled (D-216), so the TY 2026-27 version is SOURCE_CHECKED.
